decision.explanation: All four candidates are directly supported by the original sources. 'Iowa' is explicitly stated as the state where I-235 is located (D1S1). 'Des Moines metropolitan area' is described as the region through which I-235 runs (D1S1). 'West Des Moines' is mentioned as part of the route (D1S2, D4S1). 'Ankeny' is cited as the endpoint of I-235 (D1S2). None of these are contradictory when considered as distinct geographic descriptors of the highway’s location. All are retained as valid and complementary.
